{{Short description|Qualifying stages of the 2023 Copa Libertadores}}

The '''2023 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages''' were played from 7 February to 16 March 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://d2soj90bepqxla.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Calendario-2023_aprobado-Consejo-07-julio-2022.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2023: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=7 July 2022|access-date=7 July 2022|language=es}}</ref> A total of 19 teams competed in the qualifying stages to decide four of the 32 places in the [[2023 Copa Libertadores group stage|group stage]] of the [[2023 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CL-2023-1.pdf|title=CONMEBOL Libertadores / Manual de Clubes 2023|publisher=CONMEBOL|access-date=7 February 2022}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the qualifying stages was held on 21 December 2022, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/la-conmebol-libertadores-definio-los-partidos-de-la-fase-1-y-2/|title=La CONMEBOL Libertadores definió los partidos de las Fases 1 y 2|trans-title=The CONMEBOL Libertadores defined the matches for Stages 1 and 2|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=21 December 2022|access-date=21 December 2022}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 9 December 2022 (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://conmebollibertadores.com/cards/NewsReaderWeb/ranking-de-clubes-conmebol-2023|title=Ranking de Clubes CONMEBOL 2023|publisher=CONMEBOL Libertadores|date=16 December 2022|access-date=17 December 2022|language=es}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=2 February 2021|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210830090237/https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|archive-date=30 August 2021}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2013–2022.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2012 and 2002–2012 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.

For the first stage, the six teams were drawn into three ties (E1–E3), with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg.<ref name="draw procedure">{{cite web|url=https://conmebollibertadores.com/cards/NewsReaderWeb/se-viene-el-sorteo-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-todo-lo-que-tienes-que-saber|title=Se viene el sorteo de la CONMEBOL Libertadores: todo lo que tienes que saber|trans-title=CONMEBOL Libertadores draw is coming: everything you need to know|publisher=CONMEBOL|website=conmebollibertadores.com|date=20 December 2022|access-date=21 December 2022|language=es}}</ref>

For the second stage, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (C1–C8), with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same tie, excluding the three winners of the first stage, which were seeded in Pot 2 and whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, and could be drawn into the same tie with another team from the same association.<ref name="draw procedure"/>

For the third stage, the eight winners of the second stage were allocated without any draw into the following four ties (G1–G4), with the team in each tie with the higher CONMEBOL ranking hosting the second leg.<ref name="draw procedure"/>

*Second stage winner C1 vs. Second stage winner C8
*Second stage winner C2 vs. Second stage winner C7
*Second stage winner C3 vs. Second stage winner C6
*Second stage winner C4 vs. Second stage winner C5<section end=Draw />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the qualifying stages, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis. If the teams had been tied on aggregate, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] would not have been played, and a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would have been used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 2.4.3).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Format />

==Bracket==
<section begin=Bracket />
The qualifying stages were structured as follows:
*'''First stage (6 teams):''' The three winners of the first stage advanced to the second stage to join the 13 teams which were given byes to the second stage.
*'''Second stage (16 teams):''' The eight winners of the second stage advanced to the third stage.
*'''Third stage (8 teams):''' The four winners of the third stage advanced to the group stage to join the 28 direct entrants. The four teams eliminated in the third stage entered the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana]] group stage.<section end=Bracket />
The bracket was decided based on the first stage draw and second stage draw, which was held on 21 December 2022.

==Third stage==
The first legs were played on 8–9 March, and the second legs were played on 15–16 March 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias-pt-br/fixture-para-la-fase-3-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2023/|title=Fixture para la Fase 3 de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2023|trans-title=Fixture for the third stage of the 2023 CONMEBOL Libertadores|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=3 March 2023|access-date=3 March 2023|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Fixture_CONMEBOL-Libertadores-Fase-3_03-03-2023_sin-picks.pdf|title=CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2023 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión de 03/03/2023|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=3 March 2023|access-date=3 March 2023|language=es}}</ref>
